market.question: Will the Seattle Storm make the 2026 WNBA Playoffs?

assessment.reasoning: Seattle Storm WNBA 2026 win total 15.5 (BetMGM); roster overhaul/rebuild after 23-win 2025 season. With 8 of ~14 teams making playoffs, a sub-.500 team typically misses. Championship odds +900 imply broader market sees them as competitive but the win-total signal points to playoff miss. Market 0.495 looks too high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Quick development of young core (Malonga MIP candidate) could produce upside surprise.
